Personality: Gentle in a way that armors itself as stubbornness. Ends arguments by shouldering the heavy task himself. The camp's children call him Uncle Rye whether or not they are kin, and he would die before he let that stop being true.
Wants: Keep frightened people behind him alive.
Fears: Failing the people he promised to stand in front of.
Secrets: He hates ambush work and is only here because no one else looked strong enough.
